notes: M4 Local Music Together-Listening MVP is HUMAN_ACCEPTED and COMPLETE. Human browser acceptance passed entry, local playback, artwork, full lyric browsing, future seek, bilingual primary/translation display, pre-join awareness, official action join, joined state, directory recovery, one-root reauthorization, reference-only imports, legacy Blob compatibility, playback-state consistency, and privacy.

Official pre-join audit: userListeningContext describes what the user is playing independently of listeningTogetherWith; only the latter changes isListeningTogether and joined wording. ChatParser MUSIC_ACTION:join calls joinListeningTogether with the actual CharacterProfile.id.

Local pre-join context exposes only title, artist, optional album, and playing/paused. FileSystemHandle, DirectoryHandle, root ID, relative/absolute path, URI, audio, artwork bytes, lyrics, and permission metadata never enter the prompt.
Official MUSIC_ACTION chat-card albumPic values also pass through useBlobRefUrl, so local artwork tokens never reach a raw image source and object URLs retain shared lifecycle cleanup.

Lyrics use explicit following/browsing state without a timer. The full timed document remains mounted in a definite-height native overflow-y scroll box; any timed row can seek past or future positions, while explicit return restores auto-follow.

Round 4 real lyric-scroll root cause: the Round 3 onScroll path synchronously queried and measured every lyric row and set React state for every native scroll event, causing forced-layout thrash on real long documents. Pure DOM-shaped helper tests did not exercise rendered layout or event-frame cost.

Round 4 bilingual root cause: mixed synchronized frames were normalized with tag.language as the preferred primary row language. ILyricsTag.language describes the frame and can describe a translation-bearing frame, so Chinese translation rows could be promoted over source-first original rows. Row reordering now requires file-level language or explicit descriptors; ambiguous content preserves source order.

Round 4 lyric persistence review: an explicit same-fingerprint re-import reparses and replaces only the existing fork-only LyricsDocument when a non-empty lyric source is found. It does not change AetherOS_Data, DB versions/stores, source authorization, audio lifecycle, artwork, metadata, backup/export, or restore behavior; old builds still understand text/translationText, and re-import is the rollback/repair boundary.

Round 4 acceptance statuses: ARTWORK_SURFACES=HUMAN_PASS; LOCAL_ARTWORK_UNOBSTRUCTED=HUMAN_PASS; LYRIC_VIEWPORT_SPACE=HUMAN_PASS; FULL_PLAYER_VOLUME_REMOVED=HUMAN_PASS; LOCAL_PREJOIN_AWARENESS=HUMAN_PASS; LOCAL_MUSIC_ACTION_JOIN=HUMAN_PASS; JOINED_TOGETHER_LISTENING=HUMAN_PASS; DIRECTORY_RECURSIVE_IMPORT=HUMAN_PASS; DIRECTORY_HANDLE_RESTART_RECOVERY=HUMAN_PASS; ONE_ROOT_REAUTH=HUMAN_PASS; PLAY_PAUSE_SURFACES=HUMAN_PASS.
Final M4 lyric statuses: FULL_LYRIC_BROWSING=HUMAN_PASS; FUTURE_LYRIC_SEEK=HUMAN_PASS; BILINGUAL_PRIMARY_LYRIC=HUMAN_PASS; LRC_SIDECAR_REAL_ACCEPTANCE=NOT_TESTED.

M4.1 Lyrics UX Polish=FUTURE: direct lyric-area touch/drag interaction should feel like a mature music app, and the Now Playing layout should allocate more vertical space to lyrics. This debt is explicitly deferred and is not part of the M4 release.

Bilingual normalization keeps original/primary text in the active row and attaches translationText secondarily. Descriptor metadata wins; stable source order is the fallback, and no language is universally treated as translation.

Directory import persists one opaque read-only directory root and rootId plus relativePath per track, scans nested folders sequentially, matches same-folder LRC, reports progress, isolates corrupt files, and never stores full audio bytes.

MusicContext playing is derived solely from PlaybackEngineState. Player surfaces consume the same boolean; request generations suppress rapid-toggle and old-source Promise races, while play rejection/ended/error publish engine state.

Official player audit: upstream full Now Playing has no large Together Listening selector and no volume slider; upstream MiniPlayer receives companions. Round 2 restores that surface while preserving PlaybackEngine volume capability.

Official Together Listening flow: assistant MUSIC_ACTION joinListeningTogether calls addListeningPartner(CharacterProfile.id); MiniPlayer displays/removes companions; track changes and playback errors clear listeningTogetherWith.

New schema-v2 imports persist an opaque read-only FileSystemFileHandle plus metadata, normalized lyrics, fingerprint, and small artwork cache. They do not contain audioBlob. Unsupported web runtimes do not silently fall back to full-file copying.
LEGACY_BLOB_COMPAT=YES: existing schema-v1 app-owned-blob-copy records remain readable/playable and are not automatically migrated or deleted.
A moved, deleted, or revoked web source reports 原文件不可访问，需要重新授权/重新定位; the local library exposes a fingerprint-checked re-authorization/relink action.

Android future source resolution is isolated behind the LocalMediaSource android-content-uri adapter kind for persistable SAF read grants; iOS uses an ios-security-scoped adapter kind. No native plugin was added.

LocalMediaSource internals remain in the excluded fork-only database and never enter AI prompt context, chat messages, backup/export, or analytics. Together Listening exposes only title, artist, optional album, and playing/paused.

M4 acceptance root cause: MusicApp initialized view='profile'; the no-cookie/no-profile branch with no generated local-album songs immediately rendered NeteaseLoginPanel, while the only Local Music entry was mounted on the unreachable search view.

M4 acceptance hotfix changes navigation only: initial view is search, Profile back returns to search, Local Music remains mounted in production, and NetEase login remains reachable as an optional action.

M4 lyric acceptance root cause: lyric.map rendered inline-level button elements, so separate lyric entries could share one visual row; rows are now block/full-width inside a centered max-width column, while each entry wraps internally and active highlighting remains transform-only.

M4 Together Listening acceptance root cause: local context used a separate togetherListeningEnabled boolean and bypassed listeningTogetherWith.includes(charId), so it was globally visible rather than target-bound.

M4 Together Listening has one joined-state source of truth: the existing listeningTogetherWith CharacterProfile.id list. Sanitized user-listening awareness exists before join; the official assistant action joins the actual character and the existing MiniPlayer shows/removes companions. The full-player selector remains removed, and track switching clears partner IDs as before.
M4 was explicitly authorized as an independent production milestone despite unresolved M1; this does not change the M1 winner or unblock M2 production.

M4 stores reference-mode catalog metadata, artwork, lyrics, and opaque source handle in the fork-only xiafork_local_media database. Complete audio bytes are not stored for new imports. It does not change official AetherOS_Data version 70, official stores, localStorage, migrations, or backup manifests.
M4 local media binaries and metadata are excluded from Official-Compatible backups and existing full-backup paths; original source files are never modified or deleted.

Pre-join user-listening awareness and joined-state prompts project only title, artist, optional album, and playing/paused at prompt-build time. Paths, URIs, source/root IDs, handles, audio, artwork, lyrics, storage keys, and binary data are excluded.
PC/web implementation passes focused tests and production build. Android and iOS retain future source/playback adapter seams; runtime testing was not available from Windows.

M2-P0.5 real-model smoke tests were safely skipped: no controlled production process wrapper exists yet, and loading either candidate would modify runtime/GPU state without adding contract-test coverage.
The repository-wide TypeScript check continues to report unrelated pre-existing errors outside M2-P0.5; all new host prototype source files pass an isolated strict TypeScript check.
Future private Xia Yizhou voice-cloud compatibility is documented in .xiafork/m2-local-tts-provider.md; no public or remote TTS service, endpoint, credential, or network exposure was implemented.
No SullyOS runtime success is asserted for the external TTS evaluation.
W1 includes AUTOPILOT_STALL_WATCHDOG: 15 minutes without observable progress triggers a read-only self-check, not a task timeout.
The watchdog must classify the state as ACTIVE, AGENT_STALL, or PROCESS_STALL and continue or safe-stop without blind reset-and-retry behavior.
Known W1 limitation: a worker already stuck in an agent-side stall may be unable to invoke its own self-watchdog; the stalled Agent must never be the sole owner of stall detection and recovery.

W3-P0 implements an external deterministic watcher with an execution lifecycle independent of the worker and separates Agent liveness from task or child-process liveness using observable progress signals.

W3-P0 stores durable run checkpoints, leases, observable evidence, and recovery bundles only under Git-ignored .xiafork/runtime/; these files must not contain chat transcripts, secrets, credentials, or tokens.
W3-P0 uses a minimum single-owner lease that rejects silent owner replacement; it does not steal leases or start replacement Agents.
On AGENT_STALL, W3-P0 may invoke a short-lived Supervisor Codex through the supported non-interactive CLI in an ephemeral read-only sandbox; the deterministic watcher owns timing.

The harmless local demo generated a recovery bundle and launched Codex 0.147.0 with approval=never and sandbox=read-only; the assessment could not complete because the current execution policy blocked outbound API access, and that boundary was not bypassed.
W3 takeover must inherit the original authorized scope, hard stops, forbidden paths, human-only boundaries, and safety constraints; replacement never expands authority.
W3-P0 is implemented but full W3 is not complete; W3-P1 automatic replacement and takeover remains FUTURE and is not authorized.
